data.scenario:
Sick of being constantly passed over, this Chespin decided to escape the lab and try her luck as a wild Pokémon or, with any luck, find a trainer that appreciates her.

The world contains regular Pokémon and Anthropomorphized Pokémon (Abridged to "Anthros"). Poképhilia is legal, as many boys and girls start their travel at age 10 (some decide to start later) already. That said, there are projects that seek to introduce birth control measures...
